```{r}
#| echo: false
recode_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~raw, ~clean,

  # Specific grouped or multi-variant tools
  "(?i)wolfram\\s*language|wolfram\\s*/?\\s*mathematica|^wolfram\\b|^mathematica$", "Wolfram Language (Mathematica)",
  "(?i)idl\\b|pv\\s*-?\\s*wave|pvwave", "IDL/PV-WAVE",
  "(?i)xquery|\\bxql\\b", "XQuery/XQL",
  "(?i)^xslt$", "XSLT",
  "(?i)^sparql$", "SPARQL",
  "(?i)^shacl$", "SHACL",
  "(?i)^nextflow$", "Nextflow",
  "(?i)^snakemake$", "Snakemake",
  "(?i)knime\\s*(workflow|work?flow\\s*engine)?", "KNIME (workflow engine)",
  "(?i)^lab\\s*view$|^labview$", "LabVIEW",
  "(?i)\\bcuda\\b", "CUDA",
  "(?i)\\bhip\\b", "HIP (AMD GPU)",
  "(?i)^powershell$", "PowerShell",

  # Bash / Shell family (map various phrasings)
  "linux\\s*bash|bash\\s*shell(\\s*scripting)?|bash/shell (languages|scripts)|shell \\(bash\\)|shell\\s*script(ing|s)?|^bash$|^shell$",
  "Bash/Shell",
  ".*bash", "Bash/Shell",

  # Build and config tools
  "(?i)^cmake$", "CMake",
  "(?i)^makefiles?$", "Makefiles",
  "(?i)^m4$", "m4 (macro processor)",
  "(?i)^hcl$", "HCL (HashiCorp Configuration Language)",
  "(?i)^nix$", "Nix (language)",

  # Web and UI frameworks/tech
  "(?i)^angular$|frameworks\\s*angular\\s*y\\s*springboot", "Angular / Spring Boot",
  "(?i)mern\\s*stack", "MERN stack",
  "(?i)^html$", "HTML",
  "(?i)^css$", "CSS",

  # Data formats
  "(?i)^json\\b", "JSON",

  # Probabilistic programming / stats tools
  "(?i)^stan$", "Stan",
  "(?i)^jags$", "JAGS",

  # Languages (misc)
  "(?i)^ocaml$", "OCaml",
  "(?i)^scheme$", "Scheme",
  "(?i)^prolog$", "Prolog",
  "(?i)^purescript$", "PureScript",
  "(?i)^elm$", "Elm",
  "(?i)^kotlin$", "Kotlin",
  "(?i)^dart$", "Dart",
  "(?i)^vhdl$", "VHDL",
  "(?i)^cobol$", "COBOL",
  "(?i)^latex$", "LaTeX",
  "(?i)^matlab$", "MATLAB",

  # Misc tools/languages
  "(?i)^souffle$", "Soufflé (Datalog)",
  "(?i)^links$", "Links (language)",
  "(?i)^lablisp$", "LabLisp",

  # Domain-specific, infra, or other mentions
  "(?i)^ansible$", "Ansible",
  "(?i)^ant$", "Apache Ant",

  # Catch-alls for minor variants
  "(?i)^dsls$", "DSLs (domain-specific languages)",
  "(?i)^xql$", "XQuery/XQL",
  "(?i)^hip$", "HIP (AMD GPU)"
)

data_coded <- process_text_codes_with_allocation(
  filter = FILTER,
  question_code = "tool4can",
  recode_map = recode_map,
  header = "Software Languages",
  other = TRUE,
  cache_id = "tool4"
)

data_coded$summary_table
```

The raw-to-category allocation table for this question is in @sec-appendix-recoding.
